title: Developing Scientific Thinking in Pupils in Chemistry Lessons
description: This scientific article analyzes the development of students’ scientific thinking through the application of modern pedagogical approaches in chemistry lessons. In the process of teaching chemistry, it is important not to limit instruction to the transmission of theoretical knowledge, but also to develop students’ ability to think independently, find appropriate solutions to problem-based situations, and apply their knowledge in practical activities.

title: Electrochemical biosensors for rapid pathogen detection
description: Abstract: Rapid pathogen detection is an emerging issue in clinical, environmental, and food industry sectors. Biosensors can represent a solution to culture-based and molecular methods as they respond to sensitivity, specificity, and rapidity needs. Screen-printed electrodes have been used in association with nanoparticles to increase the signal and improve sensitivity reaching low numbers of the targets.
